exploit: src/router.ts registers the new handler without the requireSession call that GET /reports and GET /reports/:id both make, so an unauthenticated request destroys data
mitigation: register it behind the same door as its siblings

exploit: even once a session is required, nothing ties the id to the session: listReports scopes by owner prefix, deleteReport does not, so one authenticated user removes another user's report
mitigation: resolve the target from the session owner rather than from the caller's id alone
